list: the official 55 trophies, verified 2026-11-19 against PSN data via Exophase and Xbox catalog data via XCT.live and TrueAchievements (two independent platform pipelines, agreeing on every name)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Play the prologue through to its end and the trophy unlocks as the mission completes; the story cannot advance without it, so it cannot be missed. Basis: the official description on the Exophase PSN list; mission order per PowerPyx's roadmap.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Chapter trophies unlock on the chapter's final mission and are unmissable while you play the campaign in order. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); chapter order per PowerPyx's roadmap.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. The name is censored on PlayStation itself; the trophy unlocks on the chapter's final mission. Basis: official name and description as served by PSN and Xbox (Exophase, XCT.live).

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story; the trophy unlocks on the chapter's final mission. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story; the trophy unlocks on the chapter's final mission. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. This is the campaign's gold trophy: finish the finale after Chapter 4 and it unlocks at the mission's end. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); placement in the run per PowerPyx's roadmap.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as the mission ends and is part of the campaign's mission chain. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks as the heist wraps up. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks as the mission ends. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks as the mission ends. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks as the mission ends. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks as the mission ends. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion: everything the in-game completion checklist counts - story, strands, collectibles, activities and properties. Leave this for last; the tracker in this app covers every other trophy the checklist needs. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); the 100% structure per PowerPyx's roadmap.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida: stunt jumps and stunt events both feed the counter the game tracks. Work them in as you explore rather than grinding at the end; the board in this app tracks the target from the official list data. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); the tracked count as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles' list data.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once: when a new activity icon appears on the map, play it a single time. There are nine activity types to sample, and one attempt at each is enough. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); the activity count as listed in the list data.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge - all 42 of them. Learn each weapon's challenge on its own range, then chase gold once your aim settings feel right; medals are kept per challenge, so progress is never lost. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); the challenge count as listed in the list data.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location - 14 race locations in all. A win at each location is what counts; re-run a course until the win lands, then move on. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); the location count as listed in the list data.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each distinct race won counts once, so work across the race series on the map instead of replaying a favourite. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take up the fishing challenge when it opens and land the better catch against Cal. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game: find an arcade cabinet, play its game through to the end once. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy: work Andy's mission strand to its last job and finish it. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton: work Kenton's mission strand to its last job and finish it. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy: work Billy's mission strand to its last job and finish it. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger strands are the side stories marked on the map; finish eight of them end to end. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy: work Randy's mission strand to its last job and finish it. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone: work Tyrone's mission strand to its last job and finish it. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida - 18 spots in the list data. WATCH: PowerPyx and U7Buy list this as the one trophy whose missability is still under investigation at launch, because a Chapter 1 spot may not be reachable again later. Until that settles, meditate at each spot the first time you reach it rather than saving them for the endgame. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); spot count from the list data; missable status per PowerPyx and U7Buy, marked unconfirmed.
trophies.missable_note: Missable status under investigation at launch (PowerPyx, U7Buy): a Chapter 1 meditation spot may not be reachable later. Meditate at each spot when you first reach it.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret: take Bret's hunting task and bring down the one-of-a-kind animal it points you to. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; finish any three full sets - the tracker counts sets, not loose cards. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: use the WAiNK spot at one hundred different places around the state. Treat it as a sightseeing sweep and clear a few in every district you pass through. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges from the game's challenge lists. Most players clear this on the way to 100% without aiming at it; check the challenge menus when the counter feels close. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, earn a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the heat and escape. Build the stars together in one spree, break line of sight, and stay hidden until the level clears. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level in between: keep the heat on from the first robbery to the third, then escape afterwards. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles: get into vehicles you have never driven and each new model registers as discovered. Steal widely as you travel instead of farming one car park. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Line the shot up first: trigger Focus in a crowd of hostiles and drop five before it drains. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: leave the airport grounds in a way no schedule allows - in practice, take an aircraft or vehicle out of VCIA without being cleared for it. This reading follows the official description; no fuller method was in print at launch. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description - 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' - points at the Rhino tank: get into a Rhino and survive what follows. This reading follows the official description; no fuller method was in print at launch. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected: go in quietly, keep staff and cameras from raising the alarm, and be gone before anyone knows. If detection breaks, leave and try another store rather than fighting it out. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape after each one. Vault jobs are the heavy scores: crack the vault, take the money, and lose the heat; five successful getaways complete the set. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape: crack a moving armored truck, take what it carries, and lose the heat afterwards. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: visit every area of the state - 52 areas in the list data. The map fills in as you travel; remote corners are the ones usually left. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); area count from the list data.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang - one operation for every one of the 9 gangs. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit; the last two are easy to lose track of. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); gang count from the list data.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. The official description reads 'Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach', and Output Lag lists this among the hidden trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch. The description points to ordering or enjoying a cocktail somewhere on Ocean Beach with a view; try the beachfront bars there, but treat the exact trigger as unproven until a source confirms it. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); unconfirmed status per Output Lag.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. The official description reads 'Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style', and Output Lag lists this among the hidden trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch. The description points to driving a car out through a showroom's glass front; treat the exact trigger as unproven until a source confirms it. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); unconfirmed status per Output Lag.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The description points to the bowling alley: 'Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.' Play the bowling at that named alley and follow through on the game there. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description reads only 'A partnership with mass appeal.' No confirmed method was in print at launch; the words point to a partner activity performed in front of a crowd or audience. Treat any more specific claim as unproven until a source confirms it. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse: this one is earned by making the story's decisions as they come. Keep playing the campaign and choosing at each branch; the game tracks the choices themselves, so there is nothing extra to hunt. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. The official description reads only 'Second time's the charm', and Output Lag lists this among the hidden trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch. The words suggest failing at something and succeeding on the retry; treat any specific claim as unproven until a source confirms it. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); unconfirmed status per Output Lag.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. The official description reads only 'What the hell just happened?', and Output Lag lists this among the hidden trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch. The words suggest witnessing one of the game's strange events; treat any specific claim as unproven until a source confirms it. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); unconfirmed status per Output Lag.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED as a full method, though the description is concrete: 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by' - knock someone down with a melee attack delivered from a moving vehicle. Output Lag lists it among the hidden trophies with no confirmed method at launch, so treat the exact setup as unproven until a source confirms it. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); unconfirmed status per Output Lag.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from scores; run them through your laundering contacts until the laundered total crosses a quarter million. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The counter is cumulative across every store, so normal play - clothes, weapons, vehicles, services - gets there; big property and garage spending speeds it up. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties - 8 garages in the list data. Buy each garage as your money allows; the last few are the expensive ones, so leave this until the economy trophies are paying out. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list); garage count from the list data.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app: add ten of your vehicles through the app and the trophy lands on the tenth. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum: earn the other 54 trophies and Vice Got a Price! unlocks on its own. Basis: official description (Exophase PSN list).
